name: Branson
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Branson, MO 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Branson, MO for 2026: Polar Express train rides, Silver Dollar City, lights and Santa visits, with dates and prices checked.
lede: Branson calls itself America's Christmas Tree City, and its celebrations run from November 1 through January 7 with lights, live shows, Santa visits and a holiday train.
celebrates: Explore Branson, the local tourism bureau, says Branson has built a holiday lineup of events over more than a quarter century, with celebrations running from November 1 through January 7. Visitors find lights and Christmas trees around every bend, daily live Christmas music shows and holiday themed attractions. Silver Dollar City's An Old Time Christmas, the Polar Express at Branson Scenic Railway, drive-through light shows such as Lights of Joy and the Trail of Lights, and Santa visits at the aquarium and the zoo make the season. Nearby lake towns add their own parades, and the city parks department adds breakfast and pet photos with Santa.
lastyear: Silver Dollar City's 2025 festival ran through January 4, 2026, and its press office said the park was named America's best holiday event by USA Today for the eighth time. The park's Rudolph's Holly Jolly Christmas Light Parade, which ran nightly at 6 and 8 pm, had its final season in 2025 and is replaced in 2026 by a new parade called Stars, Lights & Christmas Nights. Promised Land Zoo's Let There Be Lights also ran through January 4, 2026.
facts: Lights of Joy rebuilt nearly its whole route for 2026 and says more than 250 displays are new, while the Trail of Lights at The Shepherd of the Hills says it has run for more than 35 years. The Aquarium at the Boardwalk says it earned the Guinness World Records title for the largest Santa hat sculpture. Silver Dollar City lists more than 6.5 million lights and an eight-story animated tree on Town Square. Branson Landing runs its fountain shows with Christmas songs from November 7 through December 31.
trains: Branson has one of the best holiday trains in the Ozarks. Branson Scenic Railway runs The Polar Express Train Ride from its depot at 206 E Main St on select dates from November 12 to January 2, with hot chocolate, a reading of the book and Santa boarding the train, according to the railway. Silver Dollar City also lists a Frisco Sing-Along Steam Train during An Old Time Christmas. Our museum guide covers the railway.
train_links: The Branson depot where The Polar Express Train Ride departs, listed on our museum guide.
traditions: Silver Dollar City's festival with more than 6.5 million lights, running to January 2, 2027.
A ride on a real train from downtown Branson with hot chocolate, the story read aloud and Santa.
Lights of Joy, the Trail of Lights at The Shepherd of the Hills and Let There Be Lights at the zoo, each priced by the carload.
Free Santa photos at Lights of Joy and the zoo, plus Breakfast with Santa and Brunch with Santa.
Hourly fountain shows to Christmas music on Lake Taneycomo, November 7 to December 31.
kidfact: Branson's Polar Express train rides through the woods around downtown, and Santa climbs aboard to meet every family.
faq: Branson's tourism bureau says celebrations run from November 1 through January 7, with lights, live Christmas shows and holiday attractions. Silver Dollar City hosts An Old Time Christmas, Branson Scenic Railway runs The Polar Express, and several drive-through light shows operate nightly.
Where can kids meet Santa in Branson?

Lights of Joy and Branson's Promised Land Zoo offer free Santa photos with admission, the aquarium's Christmas Under the Sea includes a Santa photo, and the city offers Breakfast with Santa on December 5. Brunch with Santa at Chateau on the Lake is December 13.
Is there a Christmas train in Branson?

Yes. Branson Scenic Railway runs The Polar Express Train Ride from downtown Branson on select dates through January 2, 2027. Tickets are sold by class of service and date, and the railway asks guests to arrive about 40 minutes early.
What are the best Christmas lights in Branson?

Families choose among Lights of Joy, the Trail of Lights at The Shepherd of the Hills, Let There Be Lights at Promised Land Zoo and Silver Dollar City's festival. The drive-through displays charge by the carload and are open into early January.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Branson for 2026, and here is what he found: 11 family events, 2 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (The Polar Express Train Ride at Branson Scenic Railway) through January 4, 2027 (Let There Be Lights at Branson's Promised Land Zoo), with the Kimberling City Christmas Parade and the Forsyth Christmas Parade (both December 5), Breakfast with Santa at the Branson RecPlex (December 5) and Brunch with Santa at Chateau on the Lake (December 13) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Branson

  • 11 Christmas events for kids in Branson
  • 2 free events, the Kimberling City Christmas Parade and the Forsyth Christmas Parade and Tree Lighting
  • Meet Santa: free photos at Lights of Joy and Let There Be Lights, Breakfast with Santa and Paws & Santa Claus (December 5 and 15), Brunch with Santa (December 13) and Santa at Christmas Under the Sea
  • Parades and tree lightings: Kimberling City (December 5) and Forsyth (December 5)
  • Lights: An Old Time Christmas at Silver Dollar City, Lights of Joy, Let There Be Lights, the Trail of Lights and the Branson Landing fountain show
  • Trains: The Polar Express Train Ride at Branson Scenic Railway (select dates to January 2)
  • Season: November 27 to January 4, 2027

Planning a bigger day out? Branson families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Springfield, which covers Bass Pro Shops Santa's Wonderland, Sea of Lights at Wonders of Wildlife and Dickerson Park Zoo's Silent Night.
